༄༅/gnam chos thugs gter lhan thabs bka' srung a phyi mched lnga'i bka' gtad dam can bla chags bzhugs/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/'di la maṇḍal padma 'dab brgyad steng

tei:div.tei:p: gnam chos thugs gter lhan thabs bka' srung a phyi mched lnga'i bka' gtad dam can bla chags bzhugs/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'di la maṇḍal padma 'dab brgyad steng a phyi mched lnga'i sku/ dkar gtor/ phyag mtshan/ nas sder bcas bsham/ mchod tshogs 'du bgyis nas/ las gzhung ltar bzlas pa'i bar/ las bum du skad cig gi rta mgrin dmar po thod dbyug dang me zhags thogs pa gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar mos la / oṃ hya gri wa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bzla/ slob ma khrus dang*/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ blo bcos nas/ 'dir lo chen po bāai ro dang shud bu zung gi sgyu 'phrul rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dag snang gnam chos thugs gter las byung ba'i bka' srung a phyi mched lnga'i bka' gtad bgyi ba la sogs/ maṇḍal/ gsol 'debs rjes zlos/ sman btsun a phyi mched lnga yi// bka' gtad bdag la bstsal du gsol/ gsum mam bdun/ rnam dag 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs= lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams gnyen po stobs kyi lha dpal gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje dang sdig mdzub mdzad pa khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ badzra (604)tsaṇd+ra ma hā ra ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya= mdun rten mi dmigs pa stong pa gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las= sogs/ gzhung bzhin/ bstod pa yan/ sku gzugs gtad la/ 'di ni a phyi chos kyi sgron ma'i sku gzugs yin teḥ sku gzugs 'di mo rang dngos yin pasaḥ 'di khyod la gtad pas 'bangs su tshud par sgoms shigaḥ hūm̐/ 'di ni a phyi'i sku gzugs teḥ khyod kyi lag tu bzhag pa yisaḥ a phyi mched lnga'i sku yi dbang thob shogaḥ snying po lan bdun/ ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃḥ nas 'bru phyed spyi bo dang*/ phyed lag tu bzhag la/ gsung nas 'thu yin pas/ nas 'bru 'di yi phyed 'di'i dbu rgyan rigs 'od:

phyed bka' srunga.a phyi chos kyi sgron ma mchod lnga yin par sgom shig: hūm̐: nas kyi 'bru ni re re yang : a phyi chos sgron khyod kyi ni: lag tu bzhag pas dbang thob cing : gsung dbang yongs su rdzogs par shog: snying po lan bdun/ wa ka a bhi ṣañtsa a: gtor ma gtad la/ thugs gtor ma'i dbang yin pasaḥ gtor ma 'di sman btsun a phyi mched lnga yin par sgoms laḥ 'di gtad pas khyod kyi 'bangs su tshud par sgoms shigaḥ 605) hūm̐ḥ 'di ni a phyi chos sgron steḥ khyod kyi lag tu bzhag pa yisaḥ a phyi 'khor dang bcas pa yiḥ thugs dbang yongs rdzogs thob par shogaḥ sngags lan bdun/ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ḥ phyag mtshan gtad la/ 'di khyod la gtad pas bka' bsgos pa bzhin du byed par sgoms shigaḥ hūm̐/ 'di ni a phyi'i phyag mtshan teḥ khyod kyi lag tu bzhag pa yisaḥ a phyi 'khor dang bcas pa yiḥ bka' gtad yongs rdzogs thob par shogaḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yasaḥ longs sku 'jig rten dbang phyugaḥ sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rjeḥ gter ston gnam lcags me 'baraḥ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dpal ldan a phyi dbyings phyug chos kyi sgron ma 'khor dang bcas pas slob ma 'di la srung ba dang skyob pa dang mgon pa dang sdong grogs mdzad du gsolaḥ sngags lan bdun/ gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa swa hāḥ bkra shis brjod/ des a phyi chos kyi sgron ma'i bka' gtad yongs su rdzogs pa thob po// 606)
